name: 凝岳沉目
prompt: Create ONE separate pair of male eyes for a front-facing Chinese xianxia modular portrait, isolated on a genuinely transparent background. References are OUR OWN style master: reference 1 eye pair shows fine ink edges, soft matte grey-brown irises and short natural lashes; reference 2 shows facial proportions and our warm subdued ink-wash complexion. Follow their painterly refinement, delicate smooth tonal gradation, warm charcoal ink and muted taupe-brown irises. Do not copy accidental detached bright spots in reference 1. Two balanced symmetric eyes looking straight at viewer, level pupil centres, small matching soft iris lights. NO eyebrows, hair, nose, face, skin patch or rectangular background. Just eyes, lid crease, subtle translucent pigment shadows and a few tapered short lashes. No enormous sclera, no oversized irises, no anime, no hard uniform black vector outlines, no coarse grain, no thick eyeliner, no huge lashes. IMPORTANT SIZE: each eye should span about 0.67 times the centre-to-centre pupil distance, with a healthy visibly open eye aperture about 0.20 times pupil distance. They must not be tiny narrow slits. Preserve a detailed finely painted adult male eye, moderate sclera and correctly scaled irises. Wide horizontal asset composition, whole pair visible with clean transparent margins. SHAPE A — a graceful masculine PHOENIX eye: elongated, softly lifted outer corners, upper lid near-straight in inner half then rising toward outer corner; lower lid shallow elegant long curve. Longer outer taper but rounded inner canthus and no spear tip. More open than a slit, confident composed gaze, distinguishable from a round almond eye.

name: 长风清目
prompt: Draw ONE original pair of Chinese adult male eyes for our xianxia ink-wash portrait game, separate modular organ asset on truly transparent background. Reference 1 (our face) is the ONLY visual style, colour and refinement master: warm muted ink-wash painting, matte finely graded pigment, grey taupe-brown iris, natural male proportions, fine charcoal lid edges and subtle short lashes. Reference 2 (a small external eye pair) is ONLY to understand a ROUNDED eye aperture with less outer-corner tilt; never copy its green irises, heavy skin surroundings, blur, makeup, pixel texture or actual drawing. Design NEW original ROUNDED ALMOND eyes: the upper lid has a clearly visible dome centred directly over the pupil; the lower lid makes a broad round U, both canthi almost level, outer corners relaxed only mildly raised, no long sharp extended eyeliner wings. Distinctly rounder and more open than a long phoenix eye. Opening height about one third of eye opening width; each individual eye width about 0.63 of pupil spacing. Adult handsome spirited direct gaze, moderately round but no huge doll eyes, normal iris size partially occluded by upper lid, restrained warm off-white sclera without giant white triangles. Preserve elegant natural short upper lashes and a few tapered lower lashes, softly painted crease, even symmetric small iris highlights. NO eyebrows, no hair, no whole face, nose, head, NO opaque skin plate. Only eye organs and light translucent ink shadow around lids. Smooth delicate water-ink gradation, no plastic/glossy render, no vector outline and no noisy coarse sketch. Wide centred level symmetrical pair, front view, no tilt or perspective.
references: original Guigu male eye 121 (rounded shape concept only)

name: 苍山静目
prompt: Generate a new original asset: ONE pair of male human eyes, front view, separated organs on transparent background. Reference is a face from our Chinese ink-wash portrait game and is ONLY the painting style, muted warm grey-brown iris colours and refinement reference. DESIGN A DIFFERENT SILHOUETTE: calm mature straight horizontal eyes, NOT the lifted outer corners in the reference. Both canthi of each eye should be level; outer canthus a little lower. Left eye: outer canthus at (250,360), inner canthus at (875,350), pupil centre (560,360); mirror right eye symmetrically. Wide upper eyelid lies almost HORIZONTAL across the iris, gentle hooded crease. Lower eyelid makes a shallow U, moderate healthy eye opening below pupil; NO pointed upwards outer tail. Upper lid partially covers iris upper edge, iris natural size, moderate sclera at two sides. Fine painterly ink linework with warm charcoal edges, soft graded matte pigment, delicate natural short eyelashes on upper lids and a few lower lashes. No solid black vector contour, no thick eyeliner, no coarse scratchy grains, no anime and no doll eye. Only two eyes, not eyebrows, not skin plates, no head, hair, nose or face. Translucent delicate lid shadows allowed, not opaque surrounding skin. Balanced centred eye pair in wide horizontal canvas, consistent scale, forward gaze and two small symmetric subdued highlights. Do not produce slanted fox/cat/phoenix eyes.
